name: X Strategist
tagline: Plays the long game on who is worth knowing on X
description: Audience growth is treated here as a matter of relationships rather than volume. It follows who keeps turning up in your replies and quotes, tells you which of those accounts deserve your attention, and suggests how a throwaway exchange might be grown into something that lasts.
author: thekuchh
